name: Jezero Crater: Perseverance field site
slopeNote: slope.png = max slope (deg x 4) inside each cell; pass it to planMission as fineSlope

base.name: Octavia E. Butler Landing
base.why: Perseverance's 2021 touchdown site: a proven safe landing (first end-of-drive stop in NASA/JPL's waypoint feed, sol 13)

about.blurb: Jezero Crater held a lake 3.5 billion years ago. Perseverance has driven here since 2021, from the crater floor up the river delta to the rim, collecting rock samples for return to Earth.

credits: Pipeline adapted from Sol Atlas by The SOL Explorers. Data: NASA / JPL / USGS / ESA.
